title: Les Misérables
author: Victor Hugo
current_text: The Index listed Les Misérables under Victor Hugo with a decree dated 20 June 1864.

sources.quote: The Index's own entry under Hugo, Victor is almost comically terse. It records two lines: Notre-Dame de Paris, decree of 28 July 1834; Les Misérables, decree of 20 June 1864.
sources.title: Les Misérables: Condemned by Decree, 20 June 1864 | Literature Atlas

ban_rows.note: On 3 April 1961 Spanish censors denied a publisher's request to print the novel because it was registered on the Church's Index under the decree of 20 June 1864; a censor maintained the refusal in March 1963 (Cultugrafia, citing the censorship files).
